actions.action: Clicked Add to favorites on QuantTech Systems.
Inspected the card control and navigation badge immediately.

observations: The control changed from Add to favorites to Remove from favorites.
The navigation link synchronously changed to Favorites 1.
notes: Both selected state and favorite count updated in the same interaction.
